summary.name: Conduktor
summary.one_liner: Conduktor is a Kafka operations platform offering a web/desktop-style management UI (Console) and a protocol-level proxy (Gateway) for governance, security, and self-service on existing Kafka clusters.
use_cases: Monitor consumer lag and hot topics
Enforce RBAC and data masking on Kafka
Route clients across Kafka clusters with failover
Manage Kafka topics and schemas across providers via Terraform or API
summary.what_it_does:
Console provides an enterprise UI to manage topics, schemas, connectors, producers and consumers across Confluent, AWS MSK, Redpanda or self-managed Kafka, with message browsing, replay and auto-decoding of Avro, Protobuf and JSON Schema. It tracks hot topics, consumer lag and dead streams, sends alerts to Slack, PagerDuty, Prometheus and webhooks, and offers SSO, granular RBAC, PII masking and audit trails. Gateway is a Kafka proxy that sits in front of existing clusters to centralize OIDC identity, route and fail over traffic, create virtual clusters, and enforce encryption, masking, guardrails and schema validation without application changes. The page also describes Terraform provider, REST API and GitOps/CI-CD integration.</what_it_does>
